meanings.usage: 指为他人做家务或服务的人
形容动作或生活节奏缓慢、不紧不慢
形容房屋或建筑结构不规整，延伸很长
形容非常干净，没有污点或灰尘
常与over连用，表示管理或主持某事
指人的性格或行为不稳定、容易改变
指工作努力、勤奋的程度
修饰动词，表示事情发生得让人意外
正式用语，指欢笑和快乐的情绪
表示虽然做某事但内心不愿意
指对某人或某事失去幻想
形容花费大量金钱或物品
stack的过去式，指整齐地堆起

examples.en: She would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic.
examples.zh: 她将无法就她最喜欢的话题发表意见。

examples.en: She was sentimentally attached to this house.
examples.zh: 她对这座房子怀有深厚的感情。

examples.en: She always referred to them as 'the shifting population'.
examples.zh: 她总称他们为'流动的人口'。

examples.en: They came and went with such frequency.
examples.zh: 他们来来去去非常频繁。

phrases.phrase: to the end of her days

examples.en: She carried on an unrelenting search to the end of her days.
examples.zh: 她至死都在不懈地寻找理想的仆人。

examples.en: She was put in charge of the domestic staff.
examples.zh: 她被安排负责管理家务人员。

examples.en: Not only was the meal well below the usual standard, but Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily.
examples.zh: 不仅饭菜远不如平时，而且贝齐看起来连路都走不稳。

examples.en: The pudding narrowly missed my aunt.
examples.zh: 布丁险些砸到我的姑妈。

examples.en: Aunt Harriet was reluctantly came to the conclusion that Bessie was drunk.
examples.zh: 姑妈哈丽雅特不得不得出结论：贝齐喝醉了。

examples.en: The guests had a difficult time trying to conceal their amusement.
examples.zh: 客人们费了好大劲才忍住没笑出来。

grammar.title: 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood) - 与现在事实相反
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 过去式(be用were), 主语 + would + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 用于表达与事实相反的假设情况，主句用would+动词原形，从句用一般过去式 用来表达与现实相反的假设，常用于表达遗憾或不可能实现的愿望

examples.en: If she were alive today she would not be able to air her views.
examples.zh: 如果她今天还活着，她就不能就她最喜欢的话题发表意见了。

examples.en: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会接受这个提议。

grammar.title: Not only...but (also) 引起的倒装句
grammar.structure: Not only + 助动词/be动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 谓语...but (also) + 句子
grammar.definition: 当not only放在句首时，它后面的句子要使用部分倒装语序 强调两个事实或情况，通常用于正式写作和演讲中增强语气

examples.en: Not only was the meal well below the usual standard, but Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily.
examples.zh: 不仅饭菜远不如平时，而且贝齐看起来连路都走不稳。

examples.en: Not only did he finish his work, but he also helped others.
examples.zh: 他不仅完成了自己的工作，还帮助了别人。

grammar.title: While 引导的让步状语从句
grammar.structure: While + 主语 + 谓语..., 主句
grammar.definition: while 在此意为"虽然；尽管"，引导让步状语从句 用于引出让步或对比关系，while从句通常放在句首

examples.en: While she always criticized the fickleness of human nature, she carried on an unrelenting search.
examples.zh: 虽然她总是批评人性的善变，但她仍在不懈地寻找。

examples.en: While I understand your point, I don't agree with you.
examples.zh: 虽然我理解你的观点，但我不同意。

patterns.pattern: It is a good thing + 主语 + 过去式

original.en: It is a good thing my aunt Harriet died years ago.
original.zh: 好在哈丽雅特姑妈很多年前就去世了。

imitations.en: It is a good thing you came early.
It is a good thing we brought an umbrella.

patterns.pattern: No matter how + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语

original.en: No matter how many guests were present, the great house was always immaculate.
original.zh: 无论有多少客人来访，这座大宅总是干干净净的。

imitations.en: No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't open the door.
imitations.zh: 无论他怎么努力，都打不开那扇门。

imitations.en: No matter how expensive the dress was, she bought it.
imitations.zh: 无论那件裙子多贵，她都买了。

patterns.pattern: After + 名词/动名词, 主语 + 谓语

original.en: After her departure, Aunt Harriet discovered that there were piles of empty wine bottles.
original.zh: 在她离开后，姑妈哈丽雅特发现有一堆空酒瓶。

imitations.en: After finishing his homework, he went to play football.
imitations.zh: 完成作业后，他去踢足球了。

imitations.en: After the meeting, everyone left the room quietly.
imitations.zh: 会议结束后，大家安静地离开了房间。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + so + 形容词/副词 + that + 句子

original.en: The room was so dark that I couldn't see anything.
original.zh: 房间太暗了，我什么也看不见。

imitations.en: She spoke so quickly that I couldn't follow her.
imitations.zh: 她说得太快了，我跟不上。

imitations.en: It was so hot that we decided to stay indoors.
imitations.zh: 天太热了，我们决定待在室内。

lines.en: leisurely age when servants were employed to do housework.
lines.zh: 我的姑妈哈丽特好多年前就去世了，这倒是件好事。

lines.en: She had a huge, rambling country house called 'The Gables'.
lines.zh: 如果她活到今天，她将不能就她热衷的话题“佣人”发表意见了。

lines.en: She was sentimentally attached to this house, for even though it was far too big for her needs, she persisted in living there long after her husband's death.
lines.zh: 哈丽特生活在一个悠闲的年代，家务事都由雇来的佣人代劳。

lines.en: Before she grew old, Aunt Harriet used to entertain lavishly .
lines.zh: 她在乡下有一幢巨大杂乱的房子，叫作“山墙庄园”。

lines.en: I often visited The Gables when I was boy.
lines.zh: 她对这幢房子在感情上难舍难分。

lines.en: No matter how many guests were present, the great house was always immaculate.
lines.zh: 房子实在太大了，但在丈夫去世多年后，她仍然执意长年住在那儿。

lines.en: The parquet floors shone like mirrors; highly polished silver was displayed in gleaming glass cabinets; even my uncle's huge collection of books was kept miraculously free from dust.
lines.zh: 哈丽特姑妈年轻时，喜欢大摆宴席，招待宾客。我小时候常去“山墙庄园”作客。不管去多少宾客，大房子里总是收拾得干干净净。

lines.en: Aunt Harriet presided over an invisible army of servants that continuously scrubbed, cleaned, and polished.
lines.zh: 镶木地板洁如明镜，擦得发亮的银器陈列在明亮的玻璃柜里，连姑夫的大量藏书也保存得很好，奇迹般地一尘不染。

lines.en: She always referred to them as 'the shifting population', for they came and went with such frequency that I never even got a chance to learn their names.
lines.zh: 哈丽特姑妈统率着一支看不见的佣人大军，他们不停地擦拭、清扫、刷洗。

lines.en: Though my aunt pursued what was, in those days, an enlightened policy, in that she never allowed her domestic staff to work more than eight hours a day, she was extremely difficult to please.
lines.zh: 她称这些佣人叫“流动人口”，因为他们来匆匆，所以我甚至都没有机会知道他们的姓名。

lines.en: While she always criticized the fickleness of human nature, she carried on an unrelenting search for the ideal servant to the end of her days, even after she had been sadly disillusioned by Bessie.
lines.zh: 姑妈待佣人在当时算是开明的，从来不让佣人每天工作超过8小时，但他们很难使她称心如意。她一方面总是批评人的本性朝三暮四，另一方面她又持之以恒地寻找一个理想的佣人。

lines.en: Bessie worked for Aunt Harriet for three years.
lines.zh: 即使在贝西大大地伤她的心之后，她还在找，一直到她死去。

lines.en: During that time she so gained my aunt's confidence that she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
lines.zh: 贝西在哈丽特家干了3年。

lines.en: Aunt Harriet could not find words to praise Bessie's industriousness and efficiency.
lines.zh: 在此期间，她赢得了姑母的赏识，甚至当上了大管家。

lines.en: In addition to all her other qualifications, Bessie was an expert cook.
lines.zh: 哈丽特不知该用什么言辞来赞扬贝西的勤奋与高效。

lines.en: She acted the role of the perfect servant for three years before Aunt Harriet discovered her 'little weakness'.
lines.zh: 贝西除了有各种本领以外，还是一个烹饪大师。

lines.en: After being absent from the Gables for a week, my aunt unexpectedly returned one afternoon with a party of guests and instructed Bessie to prepare dinner.
lines.zh: 她担任“理想仆人”角色3年之后，哈丽特终于发现她有“小小的弱点”。一次，姑妈有一个星期没在“山墙庄园”住。

lines.en: No only was the meal well below the usual standard, but Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily .
lines.zh: 一天下午，她出其不意地回来了，带来一大批客人，吩咐贝西准备晚饭。

lines.en: She bumped into the furniture and kept mumbling about the guests.
lines.zh: 结果，不仅饭菜远不如平时做得好，而且贝西走起路来似乎东倒西歪。

lines.en: When she came in with the last course -- a huge pudding -- she tripped on the carpet and the pudding went flying through the air, narrowly missed my aunt, and crashed on the dining table with considerable force.
lines.zh: 她撞到了家具上，嘴里还不断咕咕哝哝议论客人。当她端着最后一道菜——一大盘布丁——走进屋来时，在地毯上绊了一跤。布丁飞到半空，从姑母身边擦过，然后狠狠地砸在餐桌上。

lines.en: Though this caused great mirth among the guests, Aunt Harriet was horrified .
lines.zh: 这件事引起了客人们的欢笑，但哈丽特却着实吓了一跳。

lines.en: She reluctantly came to the conclusion that Bessie was drunk.
lines.zh: 她不得不认定贝西是喝醉了。

lines.en: The guests had, of course, realized this from the moment Bessie opened the door for them and, long before the final catastrophe , had had a difficult time trying to conceal their amusement.
lines.zh: 客人们自然从贝西为他们开门那一刻起就看出来了，在好长一段时间里，即最后这个乱子发生前，他们努力克制才没笑出声来。

lines.en: The poor girl was dismissed instantly.
lines.zh: 贝西当即被解雇了。

lines.en: After her departure, Aunt Harriet discovered that there were piles of empty wine bottles of all shapes and sizes neatly stacked in what had once been Bessie's wardrobe.
lines.zh: 贝西走后，哈丽特姑妈发现在贝西以前用过的衣柜里整整齐齐地放着一堆堆形状各导、大小不一的酒瓶子。

lines.en: They had mysteriously found their way there from the wine cellar!
lines.zh: 这些酒瓶神不知鬼不觉地从酒窖来到了这里。

questions.q: It is a good thing my aunt Harriet died years ago. If she were alive today she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation: domestic servants. Aunt Harriet lived in that
questions.zh: 幸好我的姑妈哈丽特多年前就去世了；如果她活到今天，她就不能就她最爱的话题——佣人——发表意见了。哈丽特生活的正是那样的……
questions.a: The sentence is completed as '...that leisurely age when servants were employed to do housework.' Aunt Harriet belonged to a time when paid servants did all the housework, so she would be quite out of place today.
questions.aZh: 补全为“……那个悠闲的年代，家务事都由雇来的佣人代劳”。也就是说，哈丽特属于一个由雇来的佣人包办家务的年代，若活在今天她必然格格不入。
questions.hint: 出处：听力句后紧跟的课文首句 servants were employed to do housework，并结合首段的虚拟语气判断。

questions.q: Who was Bessie, and what position did she reach in Aunt Harriet's household?
questions.zh: 贝西是谁？她在哈丽特家做到了什么职位？
questions.a: Bessie worked for Aunt Harriet for three years, and during that time she so gained my aunt's confidence that she was put in charge of the domestic staff. In addition to all her other qualifications, she was an expert cook.
questions.aZh: 贝西为哈丽特姑妈工作了三年，其间深得姑妈信任，被委以管理全体家仆的重任；除其他本领外，她还是一位烹饪高手。
questions.hint: 出处：Bessie worked for Aunt Harriet for three years... 及 she was put in charge of the domestic staff。

questions.q: What happened when Aunt Harriet returned unexpectedly with a party of guests?
questions.zh: 哈丽特突然带着一批客人回来时发生了什么？
questions.a: The meal was well below the usual standard, and Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily: she bumped into the furniture and kept mumbling about the guests. With the last course she tripped on the carpet and the huge pudding went flying through the air, narrowly missed my aunt and crashed on the dining table.
questions.aZh: 饭菜远不如平时，贝西走路东倒西歪，撞到家具，还不停嘟囔着议论客人。端最后一道菜时她在地毯上绊倒，一大盘布丁飞了出去，擦着姑妈身边飞过，狠狠砸在餐桌上。
questions.hint: 出处：After being absent from the Gables for a week... 所引出的一整段。

questions.q: What did Aunt Harriet discover after Bessie's departure, and why was it damning?
questions.zh: 贝西走后姑妈发现了什么？为什么这足以说明问题？
questions.a: She discovered piles of empty wine bottles of all shapes and sizes neatly stacked in what had once been Bessie's wardrobe; they had mysteriously found their way there from the wine cellar, which proved that Bessie had been drinking heavily all along.
questions.aZh: 她发现贝西以前用过的衣柜里整整齐齐地堆着各种形状、大小不一的空酒瓶；这些瓶子神不知鬼不觉地从酒窖来到了这里，足见贝西其实一直嗜酒。
questions.hint: 出处：课文最后两句 piles of empty wine bottles...from the wine cellar。

questions.q: Why does the writer call the servants 'the shifting population', and what does the ending suggest about the 'ideal servant'?
questions.zh: 作者为何把仆人称作“流动人口”？故事结尾对“理想仆人”说明了什么？
questions.a: They came and went with such frequency that the writer never even got a chance to learn their names, which is why Aunt Harriet called them 'the shifting population'. The ending is ironic: the seemingly perfect Bessie, whom the household trusted, had secretly been drinking, so Aunt Harriet's lifelong search for the ideal servant ended in disillusionment — the perfect servant exists only in the imagination.
questions.aZh: 他们来去太频繁，作者甚至无暇记住他们的名字，所以姑妈称他们为“流动人口”。结尾颇具讽刺意味：看似完美、深得全家信任的贝西其实一直偷偷酗酒，姑妈一生寻找理想仆人的努力最终以失望告终——完美仆人只存在于想象之中。
questions.hint: 提示：结合“the shifting population”的解释与结尾的反讽，谈理想仆人的虚妄。

translation:
我的姑妈哈丽特好多年前就去世了，这倒是件好事。
如果她活到今天，她将不能就她热衷的话题“佣人”发表意见了。
哈丽特生活在一个悠闲的年代，家务事都由雇来的佣人代劳。
她在乡下有一幢巨大杂乱的房子，叫作“山墙庄园”。
她对这幢房子在感情上难舍难分。
房子实在太大了，但在丈夫去世多年后，她仍然执意长年住在那儿。
哈丽特姑妈年轻时，喜欢大摆宴席，招待宾客。
我小时候常去“山墙庄园”作客。
不管去多少宾客，大房子里总是收拾得干干净净。
镶木地板洁如明镜，擦得发亮的银器陈列在明亮的玻璃柜里，连姑夫的大量藏书也保存得很好，奇迹般地一尘不染。
哈丽特姑妈统率着一支看不见的佣人大军，他们不停地擦拭、清扫、刷洗。
她称这些佣人叫“流动人口”，因为他们来匆匆，所以我甚至都没有机会知道他们的姓名。
姑妈待佣人在当时算是开明的，从来不让佣人每天工作超过8小时，但他们很难使她称心如意。
她一方面总是批评人的本性朝三暮四，另一方面她又持之以恒地寻找一个理想的佣人。
即使在贝西大大地伤她的心之后，她还在找，一直到她死去。
贝西在哈丽特家干了3年。
在此期间，她赢得了姑母的赏识，甚至当上了大管家。
哈丽特不知该用什么言辞来赞扬贝西的勤奋与高效。
贝西除了有各种本领以外，还是一个烹饪大师。
她担任“理想仆人”角色3年之后，哈丽特终于发现她有“小小的弱点”。
一次，姑妈有一个星期没在“山墙庄园”住。
一天下午，她出其不意地回来了，带来一大批客人，吩咐贝西准备晚饭。
结果，不仅饭菜远不如平时做得好，而且贝西走起路来似乎东倒西歪。
她撞到了家具上，嘴里还不断咕咕哝哝议论客人。
当她端着最后一道菜——一大盘布丁——走进屋来时，在地毯上绊了一跤。
布丁飞到半空，从姑母身边擦过，然后狠狠地砸在餐桌上。
这件事引起了客人们的欢笑，但哈丽特却着实吓了一跳。
她不得不认定贝西是喝醉了。
客人们自然从贝西为他们开门那一刻起就看出来了，在好长一段时间里，即最后这个乱子发生前，他们努力克制才没笑出声来。
贝西当即被解雇了。
贝西走后，哈丽特姑妈发现在贝西以前用过的衣柜里整整齐齐地放着一堆堆形状各导、大小不一的酒瓶子。
这些酒瓶神不知鬼不觉地从酒窖来到了这里。
title: The Ideal Servant
subtitle: 理想的仆人

lead.question: 作者为何说姑妈去世反倒是好事？她苦寻的理想仆人贝西为何最终被解雇？
lead.warmup: 《理想的仆人》是一篇带讽刺意味的回忆散文。作者以幽默而克制的笔调，回忆姑妈哈丽特如何执着寻找一位十全十美的佣人，最终却被最信任的贝西伤透了心。文中语言点密集：虚拟语气、让步从句、so...that 结果状语从句、not only 倒装，以及 servant、employer、domestic staff、ideal 等家政词汇，值得反复诵读体会。
goals: 掌握 servant、employer、domestic staff、ideal 等与雇佣、家政相关的核心词汇及搭配。
学会 if + 过去式(were)...would do 的虚拟语气，谈论与现在事实相反的假设。
辨析并运用让步从句(though / although / even though / no matter how)与 so...that 结果状语从句。
能读懂并复述贝西从“理想仆人”到被当场解雇的讽刺故事，体会作者的幽默语调。
lead.summary: 姑妈哈丽特生活在佣人包办家务的悠闲年代。她有一所大而无当的乡间宅邸“山墙庄园”，总把它收拾得一尘不染，并把来来去去的佣人称作“流动人口”。她当时推行开明政策，不让家仆每天工作超过八小时，却极难伺候，一生都在寻找“理想的仆人”。贝西干得最出色，三年后当上大管家，却因酗酒在客人面前把布丁摔飞，当场遭解雇；事后姑妈还在她衣柜里找到一堆从酒窖偷来的空酒瓶。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：让步连接词 although / though 与 but 不能连用；difficult to please 用主动形式表被动含义，不能说 difficult to be pleased。

exercises.q: 汉译英：她虽然极难伺候，却从不允许家里的佣人每天工作超过八小时。
exercises.a: Though she was extremely difficult to please, she never allowed her domestic staff to work more than eight hours a day.
exercises.note: 让步从句 + allow sb to do。

exercises.q: 汉译英（用虚拟语气）：如果她活到今天，她就不能就她最爱的话题——佣人——发表意见了。
exercises.a: If she were alive today, she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation: domestic servants.
exercises.note: if + were...would not be able to。

exercises.q: 用定语从句把两句合并：She presided over an invisible army of servants. They continuously scrubbed, cleaned and polished.
exercises.a: She presided over an invisible army of servants that continuously scrubbed, cleaned and polished.
exercises.note: that 引导定语从句修饰 servants。

exercises.q: 填空（让步从句）：No matter ___ many guests were present, the great house was always immaculate.
exercises.note: no matter how + 形容词/副词。

exercises.q: 改错：Although it was far too big for her needs, but she persisted in living there.
exercises.a: Although it was far too big for her needs, she persisted in living there.（删去 but）
exercises.note: although 不与 but 连用。

exercises.q: 句型转换（结果状语从句）：She gained my aunt's confidence. As a result, she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
exercises.a: She so gained my aunt's confidence that she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
exercises.note: so + 副词 + that 引导结果从句。

exercises.q: 选词填空（servant / employer / staff / ideal）：Aunt Harriet was a generous ___ who treated her domestic ___ well, yet she never stopped searching for the ___ servant.

quiz.q: 哈丽特姑妈那幢巨大杂乱的乡间宅邸叫什么名字？
quiz.note: 课文：a huge, rambling country house called 'The Gables'。

quiz.q: 姑妈把那些来去匆匆的佣人称作什么？
quiz.note: she always referred to them as 'the shifting population'。

quiz.q: 贝西为哈丽特姑妈一共工作了多少年？
quiz.note: Bessie worked for Aunt Harriet for three years。

quiz.q: 晚宴上贝西失态的真正原因是什么？
quiz.note: She came to the conclusion that Bessie was drunk。

quiz.q: 贝西离开后，姑妈在她的衣柜里发现了什么？
quiz.note: 空酒瓶自酒窖神秘地来到衣柜。

quiz.q: 姑妈对待佣人的政策在当时被认为是怎样的？
quiz.note: 课文评其 an enlightened policy。
